notes.title: Update 1.18 - Welcome to the dark side!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30649189/687205fea1e65392d15ea9a235e6cc95b92bf40f.gif[/img]

If you sometimes happen to find yourself scratching that puzzle-itch in the day's darker hours, then don't worry, we've got just the update for you! 
Twickles now features a [b]dark color scheme[/b], that's a bit easier on the eyes. 
Thanks to [i]JimDeadlock[/i] for making the suggestion.

The complete list of changes:
[list]
[*] Added a dark color mode, accessible from the options menu.
[*] Fixed order of characters for Arabic language.
[*] Adjusted speed in scrollable lists.
[/list]

Thank you for reading and happy puzzle solving!
Dennis

notes.title: Update 1.16 - Twickles' little helpers
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30649189/3c0edb63a84fa32e379f44722e1575d81427af7e.jpg[/img]

[h1]Oooopsy[/h1]
Some of you might call the above a [i]hidden feature[/i]. And you would be correct, of course!
[b]It is totally not a developer-tool, never meant to be accessed by the users...[/b]

Sadly, I have the unfornuate job to tell you that we removed the hidden buttons. We also improved some other stuff, here's a complete list for all you Twicklinos™: [spoiler]It's a thing now, just roll with it![/spoiler]
[list]
    [*] Accessing the hidden buttons in the options menu by clicking on them is no longer possible. Thanks to [i]Avantyr[/i] for finding this issue.
    [*] It is no longer possible to access locked parts and levels through keyboard or gamepad input. Shout-out to [i]Enrique[/i] for discovering this glaring mistake.
    [*] Scrolling of lists is smoother than ever.
    [*] The language selection screen can now be exited using the keyboard, like all other menus.
[/list]

[b]A big thank you to the active people in the discussion boards.[/b]
By the way, we [b]love[/b] to read your discussions and guides about optimal puzzle solutions.

Thank you for reading and happy puzzle solving!
Dennis

notes.title: Update 1.12 - Infinity and beyond!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30649189/fb69b6ea19cce1c985ecfddbe9f5ed040b6d8ab9.gif[/img]

[h1]Well, did you hear about [i]that one secret achievement?[/i][/h1]
The one that had you meddling with black magic and sacrifing your newborn in order to get it?
Yeah okay, there was a bug. [b]But we fixed it, all is well.[/b] (We can't refund your newborn though...)

Here's a complete list of changes for you motivated readers:
[list]
[*] Improved teleporter transportation.
[*] Trophy achievements will now unlock at the right time.
[*] Better gamepad support on Mac and Linux.
[*] More natural behaviour on scrollable lists when dragging.
[*] Lists will no longer scroll when selecting.
[*] Locked a tile in V-05 that allowed an unwanted perfect route.
[/list]

Thank you for reading and happy puzzle solving!
Dennis
